tools.name: get_mak_topic_sources
tools.description: Use this read-only tool when a user asks for current official-source navigation or verified educational sources about Canadian spousal sponsorship relationship evidence or procedural fairness letters, business immigration source-of-funds or financial evidence, Canadian Experience Class work-experien

tools.name: get_mak_published_source_guides
tools.description: Read-only categorized publication guides for verified already-published MAK expert articles. Use for finding relevant publisher bylines about financial evidence, work records/CEC, application consistency, PR residency and spousal-information reliability. Distinguishes author from topic contact exper

tools.name: get_mak_change_ledger
tools.description: Use this read-only tool when a user asks what Canadian immigration source MAK last verified or rechecked, what an official source establishes, or for a dated source check on Canadian Experience Class work experience, Express Entry documents, the announced November 2026 Express Entry CRS change, IRPA

tools.name: get_mak_rcic_contact
tools.description: Use this read-only tool only when the user explicitly asks how to contact MAK or requests a human professional-review handoff for one of the supported topics. Return the relevant licensed MAK consultant, contact destination, and optional public appointment-information page. Do not collect case facts

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_mak_topic_sources" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Use this read-only tool when a user asks for current official-source navigation or verified educational sources about Canadian spousal sponsorship relationship …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_mak_topic_sources, get_mak_published_source_guides, get_mak_rcic_contact · Private data: get_mak_topic_sources, get_mak_published_source_guides, get_mak_change_ledger, get_mak_rcic_contact · Public sink: get_mak_rcic_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_mak_topic_sources, get_mak_published_source_guides, get_mak_rcic_contact · Private data: get_mak_topic_sources, get_mak_published_source_guides, get_mak_change_ledger, get_mak_rcic_contact · Public sink: get_mak_rcic_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_mak_topic_sources" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use this read-only tool when a user asks for current official-source navigation or verified educational sources about Canadian spousal sponsorship relationship evidence or procedural fairness letters, business immigration source-of-funds or financial evidence, Canadian Experience Class work-experien" → after: "Use this read-only tool when a user asks for current official-source navigation or verified educational sources about Canadian spousal sponsorship relationship evidence or procedural fairness letters, business immigration source-of-funds or financial evidence, Canadian Experience Class work-experien"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
